about: Entries the calc-func catalogue does not decide by itself. Signatures here were read from the named public Microsoft page; everything else comes from the pinned DnaCalc commit.

LET.reason: Compiled by the formula layer, which owns names and scopes, so it has no catalogue row.

LAMBDA.reason: Compiled by the formula layer, which owns parameters and closures, so it has no catalogue row.

GETPIVOTDATA.reason: The catalogue row declines every call until pivot tables land; they are being implemented in full, and this function with them.

WEBSERVICE.reason: No catalogue row at this commit. WEBSERVICE fetches from the URL in the workbook, not from a Microsoft back end, and is being implemented as an ordinary function.

IMAGE.reason: No catalogue row at this commit. IMAGE fetches from the URL in the workbook, not from a Microsoft back end, and is being implemented as an ordinary function.

RTD.reason: The answer comes from a COM server the host starts. DNA Calc recognises the name and calculates no answer.

FUNC.WEEKNUM.name: WEEKNUM conflicting readings, Excel 16.0 build 20430

FUNC.WEEKNUM.state_summary: One implementation can match only one reading of each conflicting input.
